chinese: 我只是要节食。你应该至少给我糙米。我不这么认为，我讨厌糙米，我对一直吃健康的食物已经厌倦了。

english: I've been eating so much salad. I swear I've forgotten what meat tastes like. There's no better remedy than some nice greasy calorie-laden Chinese food. I might even get in order of broccoli beef.
chinese: 我吃太多沙拉了，我都忘了肉的味道是什么。没有什么药方比得上一些美味油腻的高热量中餐。甚至可能连着吃炒青菜牛肉。

english: Oh gosh, I'm so hungry. Let's call the waitress over.
chinese: 哦天啊，我好饿了，叫服务员过来吧。

english: Alright, we're back. As we mentioned, these dishes are very much... I have a certain American influence to them. And they're not really spicy. I think that's the main difference as well.
chinese: 好的，我们又回来了。正如我们提到的，这些菜肴非常有……我可以说它们有一些美国风味。而且它们并不特别辣。我认为这也是一个主要的不同点。

english: That American Chinese food doesn't really have the intense garlic flavor nor is it spicy like usual Chinese food.
chinese: 美国的中式料理并没有那么浓郁的蒜味，也不像传统的中式菜肴那样辛辣。

english: That's right. So I think that part of that is like I said due to the fact that a lot of the Chinese Americans who first came over came from Hong Kong, and so Hong Kong food is not as famous for its spiciness. It's not like Sichuan food.
chinese: 那没错。所以我想那部分是因为很多最早来到的华裔来自香港，因此港式美食在辣度上不如四川菜出名。

english: You will see a lot of sweet sauces. This general sauce chicken is like a very, very sweet sauce.
chinese: 你会看到很多甜酱。这道一般甜味鸡就像非常非常甜的酱一样。

english: We also see a lot of soy sauce in American Chinese cooking. These are flavors that are very, very strong, and they're not the same as the Chinese peppers and these spicy foods you get in China.
chinese: 我们还看到美国中式烹饪中有很多酱油。这些味道非常强烈，不同于中国辣椒和你在中国吃到的那些辛辣食物。

english: That's right. Actually, there's one more dish that we didn't mention in the dialogue, actually, but it's very famous all around the United States. It's called Chapsui.
chinese: 没错。实际上，对话中还漏了一道菜，这道菜在美国非常有名。它叫Chapsui。

english: Many people have argued about where the name comes from. But Chapsui is basically like everything chopped up and fried together.
chinese: 很多人争论这个名字来自哪里。但Chapsui基本上就是各种东西切碎后炒在一起的。

english: It's like stir-fried vegetables and meat, and now put together in just a bowl.
chinese: 这就像炒蔬菜和肉，现在都装在一个碗里了。

english: My favorite thing about the American Chinese food that we get is that we get it in these little boxes. They're very cute.
chinese: 我最喜欢美国中式食物的是，我们总是能吃到这些可爱的小盒子里。

english: When you take them home and you open them up, and every food has a box. At the end, you also get a fortune cookie, which is a very small cookie.
chinese: 当你把它们带回家，打开来时，每样食物都有一个盒子。最后你还会得到一张幸运饼干，这是一种非常小的饼干。

english: Inside, there's a piece of paper. Don't eat the paper. The paper has a fortune for you. It says, you will be very lucky today. Your favorite number is 17.
chinese: 里面有一张纸。不要吃纸。纸上写着你的幸运符，今天你会非常幸运。你最喜欢的数字是17。

english: They're very cute.
chinese: 它们非常可爱。

english: Actually, you can see these boxes that the Catherine mentions on our lesson page. It's the lesson photo.
chinese: 实际上，你可以看到卡瑟琳提到的这些盒子在我们的课程页面上。那是课程照片。

english: As you said, very, very common. Each dish is put in this little box. If you ever get Chinese food, you'll see people carrying these little boxes around.
chinese: 正如你说的，非常常见。每道菜都放在这样一个小盒子里。如果你以后吃中国菜，你会看到人们带着这样的小盒子四处走动。

english: Because they're very convenient and easy to carry. But the fortune cookie thing is also very common.
chinese: 因为它们非常方便且易于携带。但fortune cookie的事情也很常见。

english: I was actually very surprised when I went to China and there were no fortune cookies.
chinese: 我去中国时，其实非常惊讶没有吃到 fortune cookie。

english: It's weird, isn't it? I think it's funny because we expect these things to be very Chinese.
chinese: 这太奇怪了，不是吗？我觉得有趣是因为我们以为这些事情会非常中国化。

english: But in fact, when you come to mainland China, they don't have fortune cookies. I think it's a nice surprise, but also kind of confusing.
chinese: 但事实上，来到中国大陆时，他们没有 fortune cookies。我觉得这是一份不错的惊喜，但也有点让人困惑。

english: That's right. Well, a very interesting topic. In the future, we're going to continue doing different lessons about different cuisines.
chinese: 没错。话说回来，这是一个非常有趣的话题。未来我们会继续做不同菜肴的不同课程。

english: We have Italian food coming up sometime soon. That's going to be very good as well.
chinese: 意大利食物也要来了，那也会非常好吃。

english: Of course, if you have any lesson suggestions or maybe you want to suggest the cuisine from your country, you can visit our website, www.englishpot.com.
chinese: 当然，如果你有任何课程建议，或者你想推荐你们国家的美食，可以访问我们的网站，www.englishpot.com。

english: We hope to see you guys there. Until next time. Bye.
chinese: 我们希望你们届时能来。就此别过。

english: Bye.
chinese: 再见。
